units.source_text: 它幾乎完美地欺騙了周圍所有的人，然後又被聰明絕頂的人識破，

en.t: It almost perfectly deceives everyone around it, and then is seen through by someone of extraordinary intelligence,

units.source_text: 被粉碎得體無完膚，羞恥得生不如死，這是我對「受人尊敬」這一狀態的定義。

en.t: is smashed to pieces and made to suffer a shame worse than death; that was my definition of the condition called being respected.

units.source_text: 即使靠欺騙贏得了眾人的尊重，肯定也會有人看穿這種伎倆。

en.t: Even if one wins people's respect through deception, someone is certain to see through the trick.

units.source_text: 不久後，當人們從此人的口中瞭解到真相，發覺自己受騙時，

en.t: Before long, when people learn the truth from that person's mouth and realize that they have been deceived,

units.source_text: 那些人的憤怒和報復將會是什麼程度呢？

en.t: how great will their anger and revenge be?

units.source_text: 單是稍加想象，我就不由得毛骨悚然。

en.t: The mere thought of it makes me shudder.

units.source_text: 我在學校裡受人尊敬，與其說是出身於富人家，不如說是得益於俗話所說的「聰明」。

en.t: At school I was respected less because I came from a wealthy family than because I possessed what people commonly call cleverness.
